structured_data.objective: Using validation-only evidence, produce bounded research and risk directives for the frozen Phase 12 protocol. Never access test metrics.
structured_data.rationale: The Phase 12 protocol is frozen, so all research must be read-only and validation-gated. The plan inspects the dataset manifest, validates its integrity, enumerates markets and symbols, checks that experiment configuration is compatible, and estimates compute bounds. No training, tuning, or checkpoint evaluation is performed. No test metrics are accessed. All steps are idempotent and safe for dry-run execution.

arguments.title: Bounded Research and Risk Directive for Frozen Phase 12 Protocol
